title: 閃光のドライブ・レゾナンス
author: 鳴神 迅

en.title: Flash Drive Resonance
en.premise: Kai, once hailed as a genius downhill rider, had abandoned the sport after a crushing injury. But one rainy day, he discovers a 'lost AI' with no memory lurking in a back alley. In his quest to repair the AI, Kai seeks out a mysterious mechanic shop that opens only when it rains. The AI's ultra-precise calculations and Kai's wild intuition—when these two disparate forms of 'acceleration' resonate, a legendary ride that defies the impossible begins.

zh.title: 闪光驱动共鸣
zh.premise: 曾被誉为天才的速降骑手カイ，在遭遇伤病挫折后远离了竞技赛场。直到一个雨天，他在小巷中偶然捡到了一个失去记忆的“迷路人工智能”。为了修复这个AI，カイ造访了一家仅在雨天开业的神秘机械店。AI的超精密运算，与カイ的野性直觉——当两种截然不同的“加速”产生共鸣之时，化不可能为可能的传说之骑正式拉开帷幕。
